author: bardic-inspiration
name: Rotwalker
summary: A drifting, half-rotted corpse that walks until something stops it for good.
description: Rotwalkers rise in the thaw from field graves dug too shallow, and they follow the sound of work toward farms. Villagers stack them in ditches and burn the pile, because a single one left whole will get up again.

understood: the languages it knew in life

traits.name: Stubborn Husk
traits.text: If damage reduces the rotwalker to 0 Hit Points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a {dc=5} plus the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the rotwalker instead drops to 1 Hit Point.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The rotwalker makes one Slam attack.
